# Bundled images

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs.sh from `compost images --markdown`; run `just docs` instead of editing. -->

The images and modules compost uses for each shared app type unless `compost-server.yaml` names others, as of the release this wiki shows. `compost images` prints them for the compost you have installed, `compost server images` what runs on a server; [Updates](Updates.md) how to update.

- A **moving tag** (`caddy:2-alpine`, `postgres:18`) points to newer images as they are published: `server deploy --apply --pull` fetches them.
- An **exact tag** and a **pinned** Go module change only with a compost release; compare this page between releases to see what an upgrade changes.
- A **built** image is built on the server from its build bases.

The Note column says when an image is used and which key replaces it.

| Type | What | Image or module | Tag | Note |
